logo.rule: Always lowercase with the middle dot. Do not use title case, sentence case, hyphen separator, or any icon/symbol alongside the wordmark.

sprout.role: Primary brand accent — CTAs, links, logo dot

sproutDeep.role: Primary button background (deeper than raw Sprout for a calmer, less loud CTA)

harbor.role: Recycling bin indicator only — do not use as a general brand accent

clay.role: Garbage indicator only. Deepened from the original #DB7B31, which measured 2.92:1 on paper and missed the 3.0:1 AA floor for large text; #D77930 clears it at 3.01:1 and is visually indistinguishable.

ink.role: Dark mode surface background; light mode primary text. Deepened from the original #1E2B27, which read visibly dark-green on a full screen; the green family is retained but much darker. This also lifts the consult-local-guide indicator to 3.14:1 on dark.

slate.role: Secondary text, captions, metadata; also the consult-local-guide indicator

alert.role: Error notifications only — the toast banner's fill. Deliberately NOT a bin indicator and never an accent: clay is close in hue but reserved for garbage, so an error must not be able to read as a sorting outcome. Carries white text at 5.3:1.

consultLocalGuide.role: Consult-local-guide indicator — reuses slate. Neutral by intent: a deferral, not a disposal outcome, so it must not share garbage's clay.

display.usage: Item names, large numerals, hero headings

bodyEmphasis.usage: Inline emphasis within body copy only

utility.usage: All labels, eyebrows, metadata, timestamps, version tags — replaces any Inter-weight label style

utilityStrong.usage: Emphasized utility text, e.g. active-state labels

pictograms.style: single-weight line icon, ~1.8px stroke, no fill except the background badge
pictograms.badge: circular, 56px, tinted at 14-16% opacity of the bin-outcome color it represents (not a fixed material color)

voice.tone: instructional, direct, no exclamation points, no filler enthusiasm
rules: State the action, not encouragement: 'Rinse before disposal.' not 'Give it a quick rinse first!'
Errors state what happened and how to fix it, no apology: 'Item not recognized. Try a clearer angle.'
Confirmations are terse: 'Scanned. Saved to history.' not 'Great job scanning your first item!'

excluded: No bingo/game visual references (cards, grids, dabbers)
No amber/yellow as an accent color
